ln_coop_clerk.text: {greeting} Smoked eel, fresh off the smoker. Tea, if you'd rather. And snares for the water, if you're going after the eels yourself.
Good luck to you. Mind the jetty, it's slippy as an eel. Funny that.

then.text: I've nothing else of the monk's, I'm afraid. Just eels. Lots and lots of eels.

else.text: A page off Devenish? Well now. One of the lines came up this morning with a fine big eel on it, and wrapped round the eel was this.
It's dried out grand. Calfskin, that, not paper. Lasts a thousand years. I've wellies that haven't lasted three.
{player} tucks the vellum page carefully into the Fieldbook.
Sixty years I've fished this lough. My father before me, and his before him. The eels haven't changed. The boats have got engines, which my knees appreciate.
You know they found a giant's footprint on the shore once? It was a cow's. But it was a very big cow.
